# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Use a good camera - ideally a special UV sensitive one (e.g.  [Sony A7S](https://www.sony.co.uk/electronics/interchangeable-lens-cameras/ilce-7s-body-kit)).
3. Set exposure using the camera as a lightmeter (outside of the image under testing) prior to picture-taking, with care not to let the light meter get contaminated.
4. Use a tripod to hold the camera stationarily even in windy conditions.
5. Take two pictures of each point being measured - one with a UV camera pointed at the measurement target and another with a light meter in the same place.  (NB: If you have two cameras, you can avoid a tripod by putting them on a double bracket or using two people.
6. Photograph a local reference point e.g. on the bridge itself and the clock screen for record-keeping and
